REGENT's IT and Cybersecurity Operations team keeps the systems, identities, and infrastructure behind our Seaglider program running safely and reliably, and this internship is a chance to learn that discipline firsthand. You'll work alongside the team on real tickets and real user administration all while picking up the habits of methodical, security-minded IT work. You'll get a genuine window into what it takes to prepare a growing company for CMMC compliance, contributing documentation and evidence-gathering support that the organization relies on for its security posture.

This role sits within People & Places at our Callahan HQ in North Kingstown, working within the IT & Infrastructure Department as they enable REGENT's mission to reinvent coastal transportation with Seagliders. The team believes in teaching the discipline of enterprise IT and cybersecurity from the ground up, so you'll be guided rather than thrown in, with real exposure and real contributions scaled to what you're ready for. - Work Real Tickets: You'll handle genuine IT support requests alongside the team, from account issues to access requests, learning how a real enterprise ticket queue operates.

- Troubleshoot Across Platforms: You'll work across Windows, Mac, and Linux environments, learning to isolate what changed, scope a problem, and rule things out methodically before making a fix.

- Methodical Troubleshooting Instincts: You approach problems by isolating what changed and scoping the issue, and you know when to pause and ask before touching something you're unsure of.

- A Habit of Clear Documentation: You label things clearly, keep notes on changes, and can sketch a simple diagram so someone else can pick up where you left off.

- Some Scripting Comfort: Exposure to PowerShell or Python, even just small automations, is a plus for speeding up repetitive inventory and evidence-gathering work.
